description: Replace a user's notification channel and category preferences.

user_id.description: Path parameter: ID of the user whose preferences are being set

enabled.description: Whether the email channel is active for this user

verified.description: Read-only hint indicating whether the email address has been verified

address.description: Optional override email address for notifications; defaults to the account email

enabled.description: Whether the SMS channel is active for this user

verified.description: Read-only hint indicating whether the phone number has been verified

address.description: Optional E.164 phone number to use for SMS notifications; defaults to the account phone

enabled.description: Whether push notifications are active for this user

verified.description: Read-only hint indicating whether a device token has been registered

address.description: Optional device token or endpoint identifier; typically managed by the push config endpoint

frequency.description: Default notification delivery frequency: realtime, daily_digest, or weekly_digest

quiet_hours.description: Optional quiet hours window; start and end are required when enabled is true

start.description: Start time in HH:MM format; required when enabled is true

end.description: End time in HH:MM format; required when enabled is true

per_category_overrides.description: Optional per-category channel and frequency overrides that take precedence over the top-level settings

frequency.description: Override frequency for this category: realtime, daily_digest, or weekly_digest

digest_schedule.description: Optional schedule configuration used when frequency is daily_digest or weekly_digest

day_of_week.description: Day of week for weekly digest delivery: mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, or sun

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier for the delivery time

unsubscribe_all.description: Master kill switch; when true, no notifications are sent regardless of other settings

language.description: Optional BCP47 language tag for notification content localisation (e.g. en-US)
